<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Jio Platforms IPO approval:</strong> SEBI has granted approval for the Jio Platforms IPO, which is expected to be India’s largest-ever public issue, alongside clearances for other firms like Paras Healthcare.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I35</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market performance and sector trends:</strong> Domestic indices closed higher, led by a strong rally in IT stocks tracking global tech sentiment, even as FIIs maintain a cautious stance with 1.86 lakh short positions on Nifty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I44</a></span></li>

</ul>
